description: Cykelbarhetsklassning av vägar i Skåne is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Region Skåne. Cycleability classification of roads in Skåne is a classification of car and bicycle road networks from the National Road Database (NVDB). The aim is to classify all roads according to how good they are for cycling from a road safety perspective. The classification also includes municipalities in Sweden that border Skåne. Coverage: Region Skåne. The portal shows the English title as "Cycleability classification of roads in Skåne" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Region Skåne. Its keywords include Cykel, NVDB. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS, GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
